view: Susa Achaemenid Apadana excavated palace foundations, slightly elevated oblique view across low earthen and brick wall grid with a few broad circular stone column bases, dry Khuzestan plain; no intact Persepolis columns, no modern French castle.

eras.title: Across the palace foundations
eras.caption: At Susa, broad foundations mark a palace built for the Achaemenid kings. Broken column bases and brickwork lie above older layers of settlement, reminders that this royal centre already had a long history before Darius made it one of his capitals.
